warnings.message: confidence=0.85 but notes hedge: 'Utah's rooftop-solar customer classification is governed by a settlement agreement and Utah Public Service Commission order, summarized on the Utah Department of Commerce Office of Consumer Services' own page: customers fall into one of three tiers based on when their complete interconnection application was submitted to Rocky Mountain Power — Net-Metered (NEM) if before 2017-11-15, Transition if 2017-11-15 through 2020-10-30, and Post-Transition/Export Credit if after 2020-10-30 (the tier all new applicants fall under today). The exact current Schedule 137 Export Credit Rate dollar/cents-per-kWh figure was not independently confirmed from a primary Utah PSC tariff filing this session (a specific PSC document URL located via search returned HTTP 404) — left unrecorded rather than using a third-party-reported figure.'
https://commerce.utah.gov/ocs/rooftop-solar/ — HTTP 403: blocked/unverifiable, not confirmed broken — recommend a manual check
